headline: Explosion k!lls 6 people and injures 10 others in Vietnam capital Hanoi
label: NEWS
caption:
A deadly blast has struck the heart of Vietnam.

According to Reuters and LBCI Lebanon, an explosion has k!lled 6 people in the capital city of Hanoi.

At least 10 other people sustained injuries in the sudden blast, according to the reports.

Authorities have not yet released further details regarding the cause of the explosion.
